caption: The drawing depicts a single upright figure of a bearded man with short gray hair, dressed in a long multi-colored robe. The robe features a red outer layer with white vertical stripes and detailing, draped over a white undergarment that is decorated with blue and red patterns and extends to his feet. The figure's left hand is extended outward holding a closed rectangular book with a brownish-pink cover, while the right hand is raised near his chest with two fingers extended. The man stands on a pentagonal platform with green and red coloring, which is placed on a blue-gray rectangular base. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color with some areas of light brownish staining or smudging. There are no additional objects or figures in the image.
title: Old Bulto San Lorenzo
